summary: Create, explore and manage a wild animal world full of fun, play and creativity
description:
CREATE YOUR SAVANNAH… AND SET OFF ON SAFARI!
Draw the watering holes, plant the baobab trees, place the lodges and trace the paths: you imagine your very own piece of wilderness. Zebras, elephants, giraffes, lions… place the animals wherever you like and watch them roam through the world you’ve created.

Then hop in the 4x4 with Pango and friends: observe, photograph, explore! Cool off under the waterfalls, slide over the rocks, bounce on the hidden trampoline beneath the giant trees, and enjoy the campfire when night falls. Every discovery becomes an adventure, every action transforms the savannah.

Pango Build Safari is an open-ended building game that develops creativity, observation, imagination and fine motor skills. An open, immersive and intuitive experience designed for children aged 3 and up.

A PANGO CREATION
With over 15 years of experience and more than 15 million children reached, Pango has become a trusted reference for parents seeking calm, educational and kind-hearted games.
Pango Build Safari carries on this philosophy: an exploration and construction game inviting children to discover nature, understand how it works and create a living world full of animals.

WHY PARENTS LOVE PANGO BUILD SAFARI
- Stimulates creativity and imagination
- Develops observation, logic and understanding of nature
- Encourages independent exploration in a safe, caring environment
- 100% free building: children create, modify and reinvent their own savannah
- Interactive animals, lively scenery and many secrets to discover
- Simple, smooth interface, perfectly adapted to small hands
- Several pre-built Safaris to support younger children

A 100% SAFE GAME FOR CHILDREN
• No in-app purchases  
• No ads  
• No external links  
• Built-in parental controls  
• Compliant with children’s data protection standards

PANGO VALUES: NATURE, CREATIVITY, AUTONOMY
At Pango, we design experiences from a child’s perspective: simple, soothing and enriching. Our games encourage curiosity, care for nature, exploration and the joy of growing through play.
